content: openpyxl 3.1.5: Workbook() creates wb; ws=wb.active accesses active sheet. merge_cells('A1:Z1') merges a range. Top-left cell gets value and style; write to merged cell via ws['A1']. column_dimensions['A'].width=20 sets column width. row_dimensions[1].height=30 sets row height. Font(bold=True,size=12) sets font. Alignment(horizontal='center',vertical='center',wrap_text=True) sets alignment. PatternFill('solid',fgColor='DDDDDD') sets fill. import openpyxl; from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment, PatternFill. Save: wb.save(fileobj) where fileobj can be BytesIO; must seek(0) after save.
